tests.name: empty_base

weaknesses.title: DIFFKV allows negative values with no floor mode
weaknesses.detail: db:3-4=-1 stays negative. Agents treating counts as unsigned mis-page. No DIFFKV_FLOOR0 / max(0,a-b) option.

weaknesses.title: DIFFKV empty-a silently negates entire b
weaknesses.detail: Empty canary plate vs base → all-negative delta. Easy footgun if canary load failed soft-empty; looks like massive improvement inverted.

weaknesses.title: ADDKV never inserts missing keys
weaknesses.detail: Laplace smooth only bumps existing FREQ keys; rare tags absent stay absent. Proof documents this; agents expect full key universe.
weaknesses.repro: ADDKV bag 1 does not create INFO:1

weaknesses.title: SUMKV on signed deltas mixes rise and fall
weaknesses.detail: 4+(-1)+0+3=6 hides magnitude of regressions. No SUMABS / L1 bag form.

weaknesses.title: DIFFKV non-numeric → strtol 0 delta
weaknesses.detail: note:hello − note:world → note:0. String metadata becomes zero delta, not skip/error.

weaknesses.title: No DIFFKV only-positive / abs form
weaknesses.detail: Want rising-only without THRESHKV second pass; or abs delta for magnitude boards.

workarounds: Always REQUIRE non-empty canary before DIFFKV
THRESHKV min 1 after DIFF to page only regressions
Seed full key universe with zeros before ADDKV Laplace
Use SUMKV carefully; prefer TOPKEY + hot plate for paging
issues_faced: Positive canary-base delta + hot filter clean
Empty canary → full negate is severe ops footgun
crit only-in-canary kept as +3 (not DIFFKV_ADDED; ADDED is only-in-b)
